key.name: base-url
key.description: Base URL of the Odoo instance (e.g. https://odoo.example.com), without trailing slash.

key.name: login-email
key.description: The login used to resolve the user and employee id.

key.name: user-id
key.description: Resolved res.users id for the configured login. Used to scope attendance reads to your own records. 0 means unresolved.

key.name: employee-id
key.description: Resolved hr.employee id for the configured login. Used when creating a check-in. 0 means unresolved.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the panel status is refreshed from Odoo.

key.name: show-hours-label
key.description: Display today's worked hours next to the panel icon.
